description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 475](https://identifiers.org/aop/475), "Binding of chemicals to ionotropic glutamate receptors leads to impairment of learning and memory via loss of drebrin from dendritic spines of neurons". title: Binding of chemicals to ionotropic glutamate receptors leads to impairment of learning and memory via loss of drebrin from dendritic spines of neurons
